title: Human Interventions as Labels: Localizing, Steering, and (Sometimes) Editing the Computations Behind LLM Agent Failures
abstract: arXiv:2610.21708v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data. We treat it instead as a measurement: a label pointing at the internal computation that failed. We study it in a controlled agent environment, on one failure (asking a clarifying question when the request was already unambiguous), with labels from a rule-based overseer validated against blind human judgment. Claims cover eligible models, which both over-ask and sometimes act on matched unambiguous requests: five of thirteen qualified (Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b, OLMo-3-7B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Phi-4). Four findings. First, the ask-vs-act decision is causally localizable in every eligible family: a direction learned from intervention labels flips 72-100% of held-out over-asks at a definite residual-stream depth, with site and dose chosen on training data, and random directions under the same procedure flip at most one episod

translated_title: 将人类干预作为标签：定位、引导并（有时）编辑 LLM 智能体失败背后的计算
translated_abstract: 当 LLM 智能体行为不当时，人类会进行干预，而这种干预通常被丢弃，或仅作为训练数据被回放。我们转而将其视为一种测量：一个指向失败内部计算的标签。我们在受控的智能体环境中研究这一问题，聚焦于一种特定失败（在请求本已明确无歧义时仍提出澄清问题），所用标签来自基于规则的监督者，并通过盲测人类判断加以验证。研究结论覆盖符合条件的模型，即那些既会过度提问、又会在匹配的明确请求上直接行动的模型：十三个模型中有五个符合条件（Qwen2.5-3B、gemma-2-2b、OLMo-3-7B、Mistral-Nemo-12B、Phi-4）。论文提出四项发现。其一，“提问还是行动”的决策在每个符合条件的模型家族中都是因果可定位的：从干预标签中学到的一个方向，在残差流的特定深度上能翻转 72-100% 的留出集过度提问案例，其中位置与强度均在训练数据上选定，而在相同流程下随机方向最多只能翻转一个案例……
tldr: 本文提出将人类对 LLM 智能体失败行为的干预视为标签，用以因果定位、引导并（有时）编辑失败背后的内部计算。
en_tdlr: This paper treats human interventions into LLM agent failures as labels to causally localize, steer, and (sometimes) edit the internal computations behind agent failures.
